entity: Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
summary: The Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, represented by Commissioner of Agriculture Doyle Conner, reviewed the draft Environmental Impact Statement on off-road vehicle use on public lands and offered no adverse comments, effectively endorsing the proposal. The agency checked no items requiring additional assessment, alternatives, control measures, or further discussion. It indicated it does not wish to review the final environmental impact statement.
